metadata.title: Shepard Tone
metadata.author: groovy
metadata.description: Seamless Shepard–Risset glissando: continuously rising octave-spaced sines with a rotating Hann spectral envelope (5s/octave × 6 in 30s). Offline Render; Play = cached PCM.

widgets.text:
Shepard–Risset glissando (seamless)
8 sines rise continuously; Hann envelope rotates in log-f.
5s per octave · 6 reps in 30s (easier to hear the endless climb).
Render → Play cache. Flip freq curves end↔start for endless fall.
